parameters.content:
## 1. Trigger & Load Leads to Verify
Runs daily or manually. Pulls every lead Agent 1 found that
hasn't been verified yet.

## 2. Loop Through Each Lead
Processes leads one at a time so a single slow/broken site
can't stall the whole batch.

## 3. Verify WordPress + Find Contact Info
Real HTTP requests, zero AI. Confirms WordPress and scrapes any
visible email/phone from the homepage or contact page.

## 4. Confirm PDFs Exist
Runs a ?s=pdf site search to confirm the site actually has
indexable PDFs — the qualifying signal.

## 5. Save Result & Report
Writes the verdict back to Notion and posts the run summary.
